defect: pandas_scan_parallel_init was declared to take TableFilterCollection by value instead of TableFilterCollection *, so it no longer matches table_function_init_parallel_t and the Python package fails to compile.
reason: The fix changes exactly this parameter added by the change to a pointer, and the same hunk shows pandas_scan_init using the pointer form, so the mismatch is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix adapts dataframe_scan_init to the later TableFilterCollection * init signature introduced months after this change.
reason: At 66c94a2 table_function_init_t took TableFilterSet *, so the change's signature was correct; the breakage came from a later API change elsewhere.

defect: The fix moves ProbeHT to the redesigned FindOrCreateGroups API that returns new groups as a SelectionVector instead of a bool vector.
reason: The change only mechanically adapted Vector constructors and the loop bound; FindOrCreateGroups was a NotImplemented stub in the in-progress refactor and the fix is the API redesign completing it.

defect: The fix extends the aggregate executor loops to accept a selection on the states vector (ssel/Orrify) so DISTINCT aggregates can be re-implemented in the new vector model.
reason: The change is an in-progress refactor step whose flat-states assumption matched its own assertion; DISTINCT was stubbed as NotImplemented in the hashtable at the fix's parent, so the fix completes the redesign rather than repairing a defect in these lines.

defect: The new ZONE_MAP case calls filter_mask.reset(), clearing every bit so all rows are filtered out although the comment says zone map filters are not executed here.
reason: The fix replaces the reset with doing nothing to the mask, repairing wrong (empty) parquet scan results caused by the line this change added.

defect: The fix propagates file_done out of ReadAndAutoDetect and closes/advances the file so an empty compressed JSON file no longer deadlocks (issue 13212).
reason: ReadAndAutoDetect discarding file_done predates the change (it is context there); the change only deferred buffer allocation and the fix does not touch that logic.

defect: "Could not parse CSV: " + ex.what() adds a string literal to a const char *, which does not compile.
reason: The fix wraps ex.what() in string(), repairing the compile failure in the line this change wrote.

defect: The new DecimalCastOperation::HandleExponent mishandles negative exponents: it sets state.exponent unconditionally, discards or mis-adjusts the exponent against excess decimals and asserts exponent >= 0, so VARCHAR->DECIMAL casts with negative exponents give wrong results.
reason: The fix 'fixed negative exponent conversions' rewrites this added negative-exponent logic (state.exponent only for positive exponents, rounding when dividing), and the sign handling plus D_ASSERT(exponent >= 0) is visibly wrong in the diff.

defect: The fix reorders and adds includes to satisfy clang-tidy.
reason: Include ordering for a lint tool is a style change, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix reformats the OpenCompressedFile handle assignment onto one line.
reason: The fix is a pure formatting change.

defect: Routing DUCKDB_TYPE_DECIMAL in GetInternalCValue through TryCastFromDecimal makes GetInternalCValue<hugeint_t> return the scaled value, so duckdb_value_decimal (which relied on it for the raw unscaled value) now returns wrong decimals.
reason: The fix 'fixed duckdb_value_decimal' by giving it a raw-value duckdb_decimal path, repairing the regression caused by the DECIMAL dispatch this change rewrote; seeing it requires the duckdb_value_decimal caller outside the diff hunks.

defect: The fix (issue 3260) passes 'schema.table' to replacement scans when the schema is not found, and uses that name in the EXTRACT_NAMES path too.
reason: Replacement scans receiving only the bare table name predates this change; the fix extends behaviour and only touches the change's EXTRACT_NAMES lines for consistency.

defect: The fix adapts pandas_scan_cardinality to a later interface change that returns unique_ptr<NodeStatistics>.
reason: The fix title says it follows an interface change 74 days later; the change's idx_t cardinality matched the API of its time.

defect: The fix lets IsRowValid accept a probe whose first line is a comment (first_line_is_comment) when finding a parallel CSV start position.
reason: IsRowValid already required number_of_rows == 1 without considering comment lines before the change, and the fix lands on a SetStart algorithm reworked by many later WIP commits, so the comment-line gap is not attributable to the lines this change added.

defect: The added 'if (SCHEMA_ENTRY) continue;' drops schemas from the export backlog, so schemas no sequence depends on are never exported and entries that depend on them can never be ordered.
reason: The same-day fix 'fix issue' removes exactly this added skip.

defect: The added 'cursor.reset(nullptr)' lacks a semicolon (and passes nullptr to shared_ptr::reset), so the Python extension does not compile.
reason: The same-day fix 'fix typo' replaces it with 'cursor.reset();'.

defect: With an explicit column list the new 'continue' for generated columns skips pushing an entry into column_index_map, so the map no longer has one entry per table column and inserts with a column list map values to the wrong columns.
reason: The fix 'fixed inserting using columns list' removes exactly that added continue; knowing that column_index_map must cover every table column needs the physical insert code.

defect: The fix replaces result->Print() in the new NULLIF test with a CHECK_COLUMN assertion.
reason: Both change and fix only edit a test; the fix strengthens the test rather than repairing a code defect.

defect: The fix switches column.type to the column.Type() getter after ColumnDefinition members were made private months later.
reason: It adapts to a later API change; the field access was valid when the change was written.

defect: The fix binds new_column.Type() by const reference instead of copying it into an auto.
reason: Copying the LogicalType is correct behaviour; avoiding the copy is a style/performance cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix switches column.name/column.type to the Name()/Type() getters after ColumnDefinition members were made private three months later.
reason: It adapts to a later API change; the field access in Describe was valid when written.

defect: The fix (issue 3562) parses the full type string for read_csv columns so parameterised types like DECIMAL(x,y) work.
reason: The change only renamed the call; the function already returned a bare LogicalTypeId before the rename, so DECIMAL(x,y) never worked and the defect predates it.

defect: The fix varint-encodes uhugeint (upper, lower) to match the varint format and adds a matching ReadUhugeInt.
reason: At the change the raw Write(value) matched hugeint's raw Write and ReadPrimitive-based ReadHugeInt; the mismatch arose when later commits switched hugeint serialization to varints.

defect: The fix (issue 2267) takes the struct's row count from a non-list child, since list children do not know how many rows are available.
reason: The change only moved StructColumnReader from column_reader.hpp into its own header; the same Read and GroupRowsAvailable logic existed before it.

defect: AlterBinder::BindColumn now throws InternalException('FIXME: Qualified Alter column name') for any qualified column, breaking ALTER expressions that reference table.column, which the replaced check accepted.
reason: The same-day fix 'Fix for multiple column references in ALTER TABLE' replaces this added FIXME throw with BindQualifiedColumnName.

defect: The fix moves the qualified-name struct-extract logic into a shared ExpressionBinder::BindQualifiedColumnName helper.
reason: For CHECK constraints the behaviour is unchanged; it is a refactor so ALTER can reuse it.

defect: GetJoinSide combines child sides so that a child with JoinSide::NONE (e.g. a constant) turns a LEFT or RIGHT side into BOTH, misclassifying join conditions.
reason: The fix 'Fix for join side selection' adds child_side != NONE to exactly this combination logic introduced by the change.

defect: The header adds an accessor named ReadTestEnv while test_sqllogictest.cpp, changed in the same commit, calls GetTestEnvMap, so the test runner does not compile.
reason: The same-day 'fix symbol mismatch' renames the accessor to GetTestEnvMap; the mismatch shows only with the caller in the other file.

defect: The fix gives FIRST string states an is_null flag and a deep-copying Combine, so combining states no longer shares or double-frees heap strings after a combine change.
reason: The change only renamed GetData to GetDataUnsafe; the shallow Combine and NullValue-based null handling the fix replaces were not written by it.

defect: The fix renames the state field 'exponent' to 'positive_exponent'.
reason: A pure rename for clarity that changes no behaviour.

defect: The new test calls Catch's REQUIRE_NO_FAIL concurrently from two std::threads, although Catch assertions are not thread-safe, so the test can race or crash.
reason: The fix 'Fixes for concurrent catch usage' replaces exactly these in-thread REQUIRE_NO_FAIL calls with an error check that only calls FAIL on failure.

defect: The fix replaces the tautological assert(RemainingSpace(handle) >= 0) on an unsigned value, which caused a compiler warning, with a bound check against BLOCK_SIZE.
reason: The added assertion was a harmless no-op; the fix only removes a warning and changes no runtime behaviour.

defect: CTENode::ToString prints only '(' + query + ')', the CTE body, and drops the child query the node actually returns, so the string form of a materialized CTE query is wrong.
reason: The fix 'Fix toString method of CTENode' changes exactly this new ToString to print child->ToString().

defect: The new 'Test file operations' writes 80 bytes with DIRECT_IO (not sector-aligned) and opens a second read handle while the direct-IO write handle is still open, which fails on Windows.
reason: The same-day fix 'Fix new FileSystem operations for Windows' makes the writes 4096 bytes and closes the write handle before reading, repairing the test lines this change added.

defect: The rewritten update_min_max treats a NUL first byte in both min and max as 'stats not initialized', which is also what an empty-string value produces, so after '' the stats are reset and zone-map pruning wrongly skips segments for c0 = '' (issue 585).
reason: The fix adds a marker byte to this added initialization check (and sets it in column_segment.cpp); the earlier std::string version was undefined behaviour, so the concrete wrong result comes from this rewrite.

defect: In the new projection_ids branch the column map is keyed by the loop counter col_idx, but LogicalGet column bindings use the projection id itself, so columns of GETs with non-trivial projection_ids are mapped to the wrong canonical indices.
reason: The next-day fix 'fix virtual columns and projection ids' changes the key to proj_id (and moves the projection_ids move after the bail-out); seeing it requires LogicalGet::GetColumnBindings.

defect: The fix accounts for the size of compressed array/run containers (GetDataSizeInBytes, COMPRESSED_SEGMENT_COUNT) when reserving space and advancing data_ptr, and moves RunContainerRLEPair earlier.
reason: The compressed-container representation and size accounting the fix corrects were written by later commits; from this work-in-progress change the fix only relocates the RunContainerRLEPair struct.

defect: The BinderException check was replaced by the inverted D_ASSERT(children.size() != 1), which fires for every valid single-child NOT in debug builds.
reason: The same-day 'fix assertion' flips it to children.size() == 1.

defect: The fix builds the GroupRefExpression and its alias from group_column before groups[i] is overwritten, avoiding a use-after-free of the old ColumnRefExpression.
reason: The change only reformatted these lines; the alias read through the dangling group_column that causes the use-after-free was added later.

defect: BoundCTENode::GetRootIndex returns setop_index (copied from the recursive CTE node), but a materialized CTE node outputs its child's columns, so the root index must be child->GetRootIndex().
reason: The fix 'Fix GetRootIndex of BoundCTE' changes exactly this added line; seeing that the node's output bindings come from the child needs the binder/planner code.
